Context: Guidelines on Air Travel

4. The choice of the Travel agents for booking of ticket is left to the Ministry I Department. Tickets may be arranged by the office or by the employee himself. No agency charges will be paid to the agency.
5. In unavoidable circumstances where booking of Air ticket is done from unauthorized travel agent / website, the Financial Advisers of the Ministry / Department and Head of the Department not below the rank of Joint Secretary in subordinate / attached offices are authorized to grant relaxation.
